evidence: L&S, citing Ter. Eun. 4.4.47 and Ph. 4.3.58 in its numbering

sources: Lewis & Short: oiei · Lewis & Short: vae
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): pp. 104, 105.

oiei.html: Not ojei: it is unclear whether its i’s are vowels or consonants, so the spelling of L&S is kept. The form also depends on the edition: the Perseus text of Terence does not print oiei at the places L&S cites.
